Getting oranges makes sense since I'd just need St. James, and with only $242 I could still build two houses — oranges tend to offer better returns than reds anyway. I considered countering for less cash, but the risk of losing this monopoly opportunity outweighs squeezing a better price, so I'll accept the deal as is.
